title: [Main]- Warehouse shipment item tracking inherits the source line's stale pick bin on the Transfer and Purchase-Return branches, so a second partial shipment fails with "You cannot select more than 0 units"
summary: A fix for warehouse shipment item tracking on Transfer and Purchase-Return branches now correctly clears stale pick bins to prevent partial shipment failures, extending a previous Sales-only fix to cover all branches.
key_points: Extends warehouse pick bin fix to Transfer Line-Reserve and Purchase Line-Reserve codeunits
Resolves issue where second partial shipments failed with 'You cannot select more than 0 units' error
Adds regression test to prevent future pick bin inheritance issues
